name: Tree
overview: Scripture reveals that God created trees as part of His good creation, bringing forth fruit trees whose seeds are within themselves (Genesis 1:11-12). In the Garden of Eden, God caused every pleasant and fruitful tree to grow, including the tree of life and the tree of knowledge of good and evil (Genesis 2:9). The tree of knowledge was commanded by God not to be eaten from, as disobedience would bring death (Genesis 2:17; 3:3), a warning that the serpent deceitfully contradicted (Genesis 3:4). These trees hold both literal and symbolic significance, representing life, knowledge, and obedience to God’s commands.
